_comment: All tuning numbers live here (GDD 19.1: no magic numbers in code).

economy._comment: Rent on Rentday may push money below 0 (debt). debt_strikes rents in a row left unpaid lock the workshop for that day; the count clears when money is 0 or more again (GDD 3.2; owner 2026-10-12).

contracts._comment: Tavern contracts (GDD 7, 17.2). A new board every Monday. Rewards are money by the creature's rank; overdue contracts stay but the creature gets stronger (owner, 2026-10-12).

rumors._comment: Rumor diamonds on the district map (GDD 8, 17.2; owner 2026-10-12): 1-2 new each morning, at most 5 on the map, each lives 3 days; every taken contract seeds a true rumor every 2-3 days (the first one at once). Outcomes without the target give a little money (a discovery and an empty night also resources); a false lead or an empty night crosses out a tag.

workshop._comment: Workshop and loot (GDD 6, 17.2 LootGenerator; owner 2026-10-12): the first craft or upgrade of a day starts a workshop day (2 items), leaving the workshop ends it. Salvage is free and returns half. A won fight gives ichor and scrap by the creature's rank (x2 ichor for a capture) plus monsters[].loot and the trophies of broken parts.

shop._comment: The Rag-and-Bone shop (GDD 11.1; owner 2026-10-12): new stock every Monday — ready modules, blueprints not known yet, consumables for the bag, resource lots. Prices come from resource values. Trophies sell by the rank of the creature that drops them, resources at half their price. Bought consumables go into the bag and into every fight's deck until played.

tavern._comment: Tavern shift (GDD 3.3; owner 2026-10-12): a day behind the bar pays money and one overheard rumor (true about an open contract's creature with this chance) plus a line of gossip.

health._comment: Health between fights (GDD 4, owner 2026-10-12): HP and Sanity carry over from fight to fight. Resting at the garret restores a third of each; the Ash Sisters' infirmary heals fully for a day and money (base + per missing HP). At 0 HP the hunter falls: wakes in the infirmary one more day later, healed, and the fee is taken even into debt; the fight's trophies and loot are lost.

progress._comment: Levels and attributes (GDD 4.1–4.3, owner 2026-10-12). XP for a won fight by the creature's rank (capture x1.5), a finished contract and a rumor discovery. Level n -> n+1 costs xp_base + xp_per_level * n. Each level: skill points (+1 more at the bonus levels), an attribute point every attribute_point_every levels, +hero.hp_per_level max HP. Sanity = hero.base_sanity + sanity_per_will * Will. Agility: +1 card in hand at each agility_hand_at, dodge chance per point. Cunning: capture chance (capture.per_cunning), +1 visible creature move at each cunning_preview_at, a chance per point to flag a noise sign in a rumor, a shop discount per point.

skills._comment: Skill webs (GDD 4.4; owner 2026-10-12): each node costs node_cost points of the shared pool; resetting the Mechanic web in the Scriptorium costs reset_cost_per_point money per refunded point (no day spent, no credit); learned blueprints stay.

voice._comment: The Voice (GDD 4.2, 4.4; owner 2026-10-12): grows with Monster-web formulas. Stage thresholds (Whispers, Hunger, the Beast) + per_will per Will point. 1: a rage card in every fight's deck. 2: at the start of each turn an attack card in hand may play itself (hunger_chance). 3: the Beast Form card; after a fight lose_control_chance to lose control (a day passes). Rest lowers it by rest_voice; the infirmary's «calm the blood» (a day and calm_cost money) by calm_voice. Samples: a kill gives one, a capture a pure one; samples sell by the creature's rank (pure x2). beast_outcomes: weights of what the Beast did when it took over (money: a beast_money_share of the money is gone; seen: the Vigil saw it, beast_rep; wounded: beast_hp_share of max HP lost; fed: it fed, the Voice drops by beast_fed_voice); a note tells it the next morning.

factions._comment: Reputation (GDD 12, owner 2026-10-12): tier_min — the lowest value of each tier; petition_done — the petitioner's faction when its contract is finished; rival_done — each rival of it; abandon — the petitioner's faction when the hunter gives the contract up; outcome — every fight by outcome (the Vigil wants creatures dead, the Communion alive).

register._comment: The hunter's Register rank (GDD 12.1, owner 2026-10-12: rises by an exam). The board offers creatures up to one rank above the hunter's. After exam_after[rank] finished contracts at a rank, the Register pins an exam leaflet: slay a creature of the next rank of the district, made stronger (overdue numbers), within exam_days; it does not count toward max_active. Pass: the next rank, exam_reward[rank] money, exam_xp. Fail (deadline): the leaflet goes, a new one next Monday. reward_bonus: contract rewards +this per rank above A.

bestiary._comment: Bestiary (GDD 10.3, owner 2026-10-12: knowledge helps). Knowledge marks per creature: seen (a contract on it taken, or met), fought, slain, captured, dissected (a trophy studied in the Scriptorium). Each mark gives bonuses (GearMods) in fights with that creature.

events._comment: District events (GDD 15, owner 2026-10-12): no event before first_week; each Monday chance to start one if none is on and rest_weeks have passed since the last ended. danger_hp_mult / danger_damage: creatures of a district with danger_delta > 0, per point.

affixes._comment: Creature affixes (GDD 17, owner 2026-10-12: by week and the hunter's Register rank). threat = per_week × (week − 1) + per_rank × rank; the whole part is the number of affixes, the rest the chance of one more; at most max. No extra reward for an affixed creature.
